rules.paired_engine: rng = random.Random(80000 + the sum of the rule id's character codes); 20,000 draws, each n tile indices drawn with replacement (rng.randrange(n), n times) and rms(a) - rms(b) over them; sorted; the 95% interval is [vals[int(0.025 x 20000)], vals[int(0.975 x 20000) - 1]] (A2-3 (a)'s index form); point rms(a) - rms(b)
rules.c_check: a burst counts only if every SPARSITY line of it has a C record that reads PASS in ccheck.py check (bit-exact; ROUNDING, UNMODELLED, FAIL and a missing record are not PASS); a tile with any launch not PASS leaves every scored set
rules.c_log_rule: smoke, stoptest-board and every BURST session s1-s6 the queue started that ran a work launch must carry a C log and a finished check of it; stoptest-die runs no launch and carries none; a missing one: the collection stops (14) and the scorer refuses (exit 5)

dma.rule: E160's: the smoke's median launch gap less E143's smoke median is the C log's extra time per launch (delta); the session runs only if E143's longest device-held time (s1, 6.57 s) + 17 x delta <= 7.2 s, else QUEUE-HALT
